title: ESS-MAI Executable Prior Art v1.1.0 by Bledar Gjata — POC 003–006
description: A public Apache-2.0 collection of four surgically bounded ESS-MAI proof-of-concept capsules. POC 003 tests system cold-start reachability; POC 004 tests bounded GCL LAW-0 continuity; POC 005 tests FFI authority non-duplication while preserving the direct-write hold; POC 006 tests verified negative-history re-entry and fail-closed omission prevention while exposing the remaining Boolean-only receipt gap. POC 006 also maps source-evidenced constructive K+ and rigorous-negative K- as distinct sibling knowledge outcomes under GCL, with HOLD separate from both, and maps a publisher-timestamped 2026-06-03 ESS-MAI Negative Knowledge disclosure to later executable evidence without inflating the media record into an implementation claim. Experimental success and experimental failure are preserved together as an architecture-preserving advancement method. Earlier failure-memory and positive/negative knowledge work is acknowledged as prior art. The full ESS-MAI v1.8.9 core is not included.
